scientific_integrity: Analytical proofs, exact normalization, stated limitations and separately executable bounded numerical checks; underlying stationary mixture attributed to cited prior work.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite N>=3, one-dimensional unbiased Brownian particles with identical diffusivity and a common upper threshold; stationary law only; large-R limits require fixed positive excursion thresholds. Generic scale-mixture theory and undiscovered comparisons are residual priority risks. Conditional age limit does not describe unconditional ages. No independent review.
title: Finite-\(N\) joint escape tails and the moment budget of a first-passage resetting gas
